Security at Ledgerly

Security is part of how we build. All customer data is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) in the eu-west-1 region.

We encrypt data with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit. Access to production is limited to on-call engineers and reviewed every quarter.

We run annual penetration tests with an independent firm and patch critical issues within 7 days.

Questions about our security programme? Write to security@ledgerly.io and our team will respond within two business days.

Our infrastructure is monitored 24/7, backups are taken daily and restored in drills twice a year.
